slots.part: Enterprise · APIs III: receiving webhooks safely

videos.watch_for: How the X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC is computed over the raw body with your secret, and why you compare with a constant-time function.

slots.part: Enterprise · APIs III: receiving webhooks safely
slots.day_title: Tests with pytest, and doing many calls at once

videos.oembed_title: Building resilient webhook systems at scale
videos.watch_for: Duplicates and out-of-order delivery, idempotency strategies, and the core rule the lesson applies to GitHub: ingest, verify, queue, then process asynchronously.
videos.why_this_one: Hookdeck engineer's talk on the Stripe Developers channel, built on handling billions of webhooks; chaptered.

videos.oembed_title: Implementing Signature Verification for Webhooks (GitHub HMAC verification)
videos.watch_for: How a GitHub webhook secret produces an HMAC-SHA256 signature header and how the receiver recomputes and compares it to reject forged requests.
videos.why_this_one: Webhook-infrastructure vendor's focused demo using GitHub as the provider; chaptered.
videos.code_note: Watch for the idea, not the code: the demo is not in Python and routes traffic through Hookdeck's tool; the lesson verifies the signature in its own receiver (use a constant-time compare).
